title: 10 Best Capsicum Annuum Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Capsicum annuum are tinctures, teas, capsules, decoctions, and creams, each offering unique benefits for health and wellness. Tinctures provide a concentrated form of capsaicin, often used for pain relief and inflammation reduction. Teas made from dried capsicum leaves can aid digestion and promote circulation. Capsules offer a convenient and standardized dose for consistent therapeutic effects. Decoctions involve simmering the herb to extract its active compounds, commonly used in traditional medicine. Creams infused with capsaicin are widely used topically to alleviate muscle pain and arthritis symptoms.

Capsicum annuum tinctures are also believed to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects that support overall health.
